verdict.rationale: CoreWeave offers infrastructure-level automation that runs unattended. The Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler scales Node Pools on its own as workload demand changes, bucket lifecycle policies expire objects automatically, and Slurm via SUNK runs batch jobs in the background. Terraform and the APIs allow programmatic orchestration, but you must assemble the automations yourself from Kubernetes and Slurm primitives rather than through a first-class automation feature. Missing for 10: a native scheduled-task or trigger system, agent-driven automation workflows, documentation on setting up autonomous background automations end to end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
